contract: Road user a has completed a turn to the left. Its heading change over the window behind the observation (prim.heading_change over a window of length window, degrees, positive to the left) lies in the band from turn_min inclusive to u_turn_min exclusive, so that a heading change too small to be a turn and a reversal of direction both lie outside it. The act begins within the window behind the observation at which it is recognized. The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change over the window behind lies in that band and a's yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) is at most yaw_tol in magnitude, where this did not hold at the previous observation: the heading has stopped turning. The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until that condition has ceased to hold and then holds again. Conduct before the window behind is not read: a turn that takes longer than the window is not recognized. It denotes the change of a's heading only: it says nothing of the lane, the intersection or the way on which a turns, of its speed, or of why it turns. Not denoted: a heading change to the left smaller than turn_min, such as a lane change or a drift; a heading change of u_turn_min or more, which is a reversal of direction; a turn to the right; a turn still under way, whose yaw rate exceeds yaw_tol. Where the window is truncated or sampled too sparsely, or a yaw rate in it is missing, it is unknown.

params.name: window
params.meaning: the length of the window behind the observation over which the heading change is integrated: the longest duration of a turn

params.name: turn_min
params.meaning: the smallest heading change that is a turn

params.name: u_turn_min
params.meaning: the smallest heading change that is a reversal of direction, which bounds the band of a turn from above

params.name: yaw_tol
params.meaning: the yaw-rate magnitude at or below which the heading counts as no longer turning: the source's yaw-rate resolution

act.onset: The act begins within the window behind the observation at which it is recognized.
act.recognition: The act is recognized at the observation at which the heading change over the window behind lies in that band and a's yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) is at most yaw_tol in magnitude, where this did not hold at the previous observation: the heading has stopped turning.
act.extent: The concept holds at that observation only, and not again until that condition has ceased to hold and then holds again.
act.history: Conduct before the window behind is not read: a turn that takes longer than the window is not recognized.

elements.span: Its heading change over the window behind the observation (prim.heading_change over a window of length window, degrees, positive to the left) lies in the band from turn_min inclusive to u_turn_min exclusive
elements.justification: prim.heading_change is 'the signed heading change (degrees, left positive) of a road user over the window behind the observation, integrated from kin.yaw_rate; unknown where the window is truncated, sampled too sparsely, or a yaw rate is missing'; a positive value in the band is a turn to the left, a negative one a turn to the right.

elements.span: a's yaw rate (kin.yaw_rate) is at most yaw_tol in magnitude
elements.justification: kin.yaw_rate is the 'rate of change of heading, positive when the heading turns to the left'; at or below the tolerance in magnitude the heading has stopped turning, which marks the turn complete. It is not read as road curvature, its exclusion: it is the road user's own heading change.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle riding straight with zero yaw rate turns to the left at a constant yaw rate for 6 s, 90 degrees in all, the whole turn lying inside the window behind the observation that follows it. Its heading at each observation is the heading at the observation before, turned by the yaw rate recorded at that observation times the interval before it (the rate at a scene is held over the interval before it), so the heading changes at the first observation that records the turning rate and stops changing at the first observation that records a zero rate. At that first observation with zero yaw rate the heading change over the window is 90 degrees and the yaw rate was above yaw_tol at the observation before: the concept holds there.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: A bicycle changes lane to the left: its heading turns 10 degrees to the left and then back, each heading being the one at the observation before turned by the yaw rate recorded at that observation times the interval before it, and its yaw rate is zero before and after. Over every covered window its heading change stays below turn_min, so the concept does not hold at any observation.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: The holds trace, with the bicycle's yaw rate not observed by the source: at the observation where the turn would be recognized neither the heading change over the window nor the yaw rate is known, and the concept is unknown.
